bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
f="$root/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py"
stage="$root/.releases/video-sale-readback-295952ab"
unit=gace-userbot-verify.service
session="$root/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active "$unit")" = active || exit 61
test -S "$root/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock" || exit 62
test "$(stat -c %a "$session")" = 600 || exit 63
before="$(stat -c '%d:%i' "$session")"
cp -p "$f" "$stage/before-video-spoiler-fix.py"
python3 -B - "$f" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import ast,sys
p=Path(sys.argv[1]);s=p.read_text()
a='for m in free]'
b='for m in messages[:2]]'
c='getattr(free[0],"raw_text","")'
d='getattr(messages[0],"raw_text","")'
if s.count(a)!=2 or s.count(c)!=1:sys.exit(65)
s=s.replace(a,b).replace(c,d)
ast.parse(s)
p.write_text(s)
PY
armed=YES
rollback(){ cp -p "$stage/before-video-spoiler-fix.py" "$f" || true;systemctl --user restart "$unit" || true; }
trap 'if test "$armed" = YES;then rollback;fi' EXIT
systemctl --user restart "$unit" || exit 66
ready=NO
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8;do
 if test "$(systemctl --user is-active "$unit" 2>/dev/null)" = active && test -S "$root/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock";then ready=YES;break;fi
 sleep 2
done
test "$ready" = YES || exit 67
python3 -B "$root/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health | grep -Fq 'USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=PASS' || exit 68
test "$(stat -c '%d:%i' "$session")" = "$before" && test "$(stat -c %a "$session")" = 600 || exit 69
armed=NO
echo RESIDENT_USERBOT_SPOILER_READBACK_CORRECTED=PASS
